_comment: CANONICAL activation receipt template — schema naya.activation.receipt.v2. This is the ONE receipt schema enforced by tools/activation_gate.py. v1 (ACTIVATION-RECEIPT-TEMPLATE.json) is retired for pre-delivery enforcement. A receipt is minted by the protected runner at the pre-delivery boundary: repository, main_sha, and loaded fingerprints are resolved from live GitHub state, never supplied by the builder. The shipped artifact must carry <!-- NAYA-ACTIVATION-RECEIPT-SHA256:<sha256 of the exact receipt bytes> -->. deliverables scopes the receipt per-deliverable: a non-empty list of {path, sha256} entries; each sha256 is the sha256 of the canonical (citation-marker-stripped) bytes of that deliverable, computed at mint time.

deliverables._comment: minted by the protected runner: path = repo-relative path of the shipped artifact; sha256 = sha256 of its canonical bytes with the receipt citation marker stripped.
deliverables.sha256: <64-hex sha256 of the canonical deliverable bytes>

loaded._comment: CLOSED-WORLD: keys must be exactly the CANONICAL_SOURCES registry in tools/activation_gate.py; each value the 40-hex blob SHA of that file in the live main tree.

main_sha: <full 40-hex SHA of live main, resolved by the protected runner>
repository: <resolved by the protected runner from GITHUB_REPOSITORY>
